problem_text:
A logistics company needs to allocate its delivery capacity among 20 regional distribution centers to maximize total expected delivery throughput. The characteristics of each center are as follows:
* Center A: expected throughput is 0.145, operational complexity is 0.241, capacity bounds [0.017, 0.678]
* Center B: expected throughput is 0.100, operational complexity is 0.109, capacity bounds [0.007, 0.744]
* Center C: expected throughput is 0.192, operational complexity is 0.044, capacity bounds [0.051, 0.561]
* Center D: expected throughput is 0.094, operational complexity is 0.128, capacity bounds [0.053, 0.755]
* Center E: expected throughput is 0.034, operational complexity is 0.156, capacity bounds [0.039, 0.720]
* Center F: expected throughput is 0.121, operational complexity is 0.053, capacity bounds [0.042, 0.740]
* Center G: expected throughput is 0.034, operational complexity is 0.153, capacity bounds [0.013, 0.734]
* Center H: expected throughput is 0.085, operational complexity is 0.266, capacity bounds [0.070, 0.654]
* Center I: expected throughput is 0.107, operational complexity is 0.067, capacity bounds [0.024, 0.792]
* Center J: expected throughput is 0.061, operational complexity is 0.062, capacity bounds [0.029, 0.606]
* Center K: expected throughput is 0.162, operational complexity is 0.142, capacity bounds [0.034, 0.391]
* Center L: expected throughput is 0.061, operational complexity is 0.058, capacity bounds [0.082, 0.305]
* Center M: expected throughput is 0.169, operational complexity is 0.131, capacity bounds [0.034, 0.656]
* Center N: expected throughput is 0.198, operational complexity is 0.232, capacity bounds [0.061, 0.704]
* Center O: expected throughput is 0.187, operational complexity is 0.216, capacity bounds [0.011, 0.572]
* Center P: expected throughput is 0.064, operational complexity is 0.146, capacity bounds [0.072, 0.492]
* Center Q: expected throughput is 0.184, operational complexity is 0.039, capacity bounds [0.007, 0.406]
* Center R: expected throughput is 0.141, operational complexity is 0.262, capacity bounds [0.092, 0.734]
* Center S: expected throughput is 0.140, operational complexity is 0.252, capacity bounds [0.095, 0.468]
* Center T: expected throughput is 0.129, operational complexity is 0.017, capacity bounds [0.091, 0.764]

Each center must receive a proportion of the total delivery capacity that satisfies its individual lower and upper bounds, and the total of all capacity proportions must sum to one. To ensure adequate coverage in high-priority regions, the company requires that the group of strategic centers, represented by the subset S = {D, I, J, O, P, T}, collectively receive at least 0.303 of the total capacity. At the same time, the overall operational complexity index must not exceed 0.217, and the total expected throughput must be no less than 0.083. Please determine the optimal capacity allocation weights that maximize total expected throughput subject to all constraints.
